rationale_overall: The cap dropped from 5 to 2 this quarter, forcing three removes in one call to comply. I kept the two names with the most direct, dated Q1-2022 evidence of AI-wave exposure: NVDA (record Q4 FY22 gaming/datacenter revenue, reported Feb 16 2022) and MSFT (Azure +46% YoY, reported Jan 25 2022). AAPL was cut as a diversified consumer-hardware business with no wave alignment; GOOGL was cut because its Q4 2021 results remain overwhelmingly ad-driven; SPY was cut as undifferentiated broad-market beta as the Fed's tightening cycle began. Pass-1 discovery across the other waves surfaced no clean, correctly-dated candidate strong enough to add. The watchlist now sits exactly at max_watchlist_size=2 (NVDA, MSFT).
